article.title: Procedure of Court in case of question being asked without reasonable grounds
article.content: If the Court is of opinion that any such question was asked without reasonable grounds, it may, if it was asked by any advocate, report the circumstances of the case to the High Court or other authority to which such advocate is subject in the exercise of his profession.
article.html:
153Procedure of Court in case of question being asked without reasonable grounds

Section 153 · Part IV · Chapter X

If the Court is of opinion that any such question was asked without reasonable grounds, it may, if it was asked by any advocate, report the circumstances of the case to the High Court or other authority to which such advocate is subject in the exercise of his profession.
